Name: FOOT_IK_PARAM_ST
Description: Foot IK settings: how quickly foot placement, ankle angle and slope tilt blend in and out as the ground changes.

Fields.Name: Interpolation Time on IK Toggle
Fields.Description: Interpolation time when IK is switched on or off. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Gain on IK Toggle
Fields.Description: Gain applied when foot placement is switched on or off.

Fields.Name: Gain on Ground Height Increase
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when the ground height increases.

Fields.Name: Gain on Ground Height Decrease
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when the ground height decreases.

Fields.Name: Gain on Foot Raise
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when a foot is raised.

Fields.Name: Gain on Foot Plant
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when a foot is planted to the ground.

Fields.Name: Gain on Foot Lock Toggle
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when a foot is locked or unlocked.

Fields.Name: Gain on Ankle Rotation
Fields.Description: Determines the amount of gain applied when an ankle is rotating.

Fields.Name: Twist Knee Axis Type
Fields.Description: Axial direction that ignores rotation of the knee joint for twisting.

Fields.Name: Use Foot Placement
Fields.Description: If ON, foot placement is active.

Fields.Name: Apply Slope Adjustment Offset
Fields.Description: If ON, apply slope offset adjustment when sliding down a slope.

Fields.Name: Slope: Forward Lean Ratio
Fields.Description: Specifies the amount of front/back lean against the slope when the slope is tilted.

Fields.Name: Slope: Side Lean Ratio
Fields.Description: Specifies the amount of right/left lean against the slope when the slope is tilted.

Fields.Name: Slope: Gain
Fields.Description: Gain used to tilt the character to follow the slope.
